This disables the engine’s check that each material’s print temperature lies within every other material’s recommended range. Incompatible temperatures can cause failed prints. Only enable it for a combination you have checked. Invalid temperature ranges remain errors.

Use #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. With automatic flushing enabled, the engine recalculates this slot’s row and column. Other manual matrix cells stay unchanged.
